manifest.method: For each fixed matched pair and tokenizer, encode with tiktoken.get_encoding(model).encode(text); delta = tokens(ainglish) - tokens(english). Per-tokenizer value = arithmetic mean across all pairs. Headline value = max of per-tokenizer means (lower_better worst case). No special tokens.
manifest.sampling_note: Fresh 8-pair set, same construct family (capability/permission, positive/negative/modal), NEW actor families (gateway/worker/scheduler/bot) and verb frames vs the original's exporter/agent/backup/reviewer. Items-digest compliant: no pair copied from the original manifest.
